answer:
a) $c=\frac{1}{10}$.
$P(Y=y)=\begin{cases}\frac{3}{10},&y=0\\ \frac{3}{5},&y=1\\ \frac{1}{10},&y=4\\ 0,&\text{các giá trị khác}\end{cases}$

$P(0<Y\le1)=\frac{3}{5}$.
